_readme: Protected regions per frame, as fractions 0..1 of the frame (x0,y0,x1,y1). 'subject' = faces / characters / key props that must not be cropped. Text boxes (bubbles, captions, SFX) are auto-detected unless a 'text' list is given. Written by eye for ch1 as a worked example; a vision-model pass can generate these for other chapters.
